text:
we put an 8B LLM inside a solana fork. every token it writes is computed on-chain, in public, one transaction at a time.

CA: DxNXApfiPXYcobrM3NsePAXMDYyaPgB8jfK4yc9ichat ($CHAT)
try it: https://t.co/8wzpO6pi0i
watch one compute: https://t.co/nEXJJkN5Bt

what's on-chain
• qwen3-8b, all 36 layers, quantized to 4-bit
• 4.22 GB of weights uploaded into 569 accounts (~7.4 MB each)
• one program does the math: rmsnorm, q/k/v projections, rope, attention over a kv cache that lives in accounts, the swiglu ffn, the final 151,936-row vocab projection and the argmax that picks the next token
• off-chain: only converting your text to token ids and back. everything in between is transactions

the chain: crekk
• an agave 4.3 fork running as a single validator, ~151ms slots
• mainnet caps a transaction at 1.4M compute units. one token of an 8B model is ~8 billion multiply-adds, so we raised the per-tx cap to u32 max (~4.3B CU) and the block cap to 2^52
• then we patched agave's block scheduler: keep 32 worker threads full every slot, and skip read-lock checks on the weights (they're read-only; the bank still enforces real locks)

how a reply gets computed
• every weight matrix is cut into blocks of a few hundred rows. each block is its own transaction, so hundreds land in parallel and get merged
• each piece is sized to ~12M CU so it fits in one slot (~12.7 CU per 4-bit multiply-add, measured)
• your whole prompt goes through as one batch: each weight row is read once and applied to every prompt token (up to 32) at the same time
• then the reply decodes token by token, each one fed back in as the next input

speed
• v1: 43 minutes per token
• now, on an idle chain: ~1.5 min per reply token, and a ~17-token prompt batch in ~9 min
• a short chat ("hi" → "Hi") takes ~20–30 min
• several chats run at once (3 today; the cap is one validator's throughput, not code)
• 100k+ transactions per short chat, each with a public receipt

proof
• we replay the on-chain batch natively and diff it: 0 of 8,064 kv cache entries differ, 0 activation bytes differ, same token. bit for bit

using it
• free. stacc sponsors every fee, no wallet needed
• every chat is public, with live progress, an eta and receipts
• open someone else's finished chat and fork it to keep going in your own
• a public log of every generation: prompt, reply, timing, links

getting assets onto crekk
• https://t.co/J0nFw7Dp1Q bridges tokens between solana mainnet and crekk. it's one relayer for now, so treat it as custodialish
• crekk's rpc has an airdrop faucet for gas
• pending: raydium clmm + cpmm pools on crekk and a native wSOL mint, so bridged tokens get real markets next to the model, just cuz we can

$CHAT
• https://t.co/xhA6XrAO47 coin, CA DxNXApfiPXYcobrM3NsePAXMDYyaPgB8jfK4yc9ichat
• its image is a live headless screenshot of the model's latest finished chat. every time the model finishes a reply, the coin's picture changes and its website points at that chat

why
mainnet isn't running this tomorrow. but none of it needs a new primitive: it's compute limits, scheduler config and hardware. if @toly @SolanaFndn @solana wanted a GLM-class model on solana, that's a config decision, not a research project. this is the slow, ugly, public proof: it's performance art.

第1003期 小路和你读AI论文。今日4篇高质量论文。

1. 𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘁𝘂𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗦𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴: 𝗦𝗙𝗧 𝗟𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻𝘀 𝗕𝗲𝘁𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗧𝗵𝗮𝗻 𝗬𝗼𝘂 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝗻𝗸（《带采样的微调：SFT 比你想的更会学》）

链接：https://t.co/QXVXbqz5hu

作者背景：Aayush Karan, Sitan Chen, Yilun Du, Harvard

不改损失，用 MCMC 把离策略专家轨迹逐步改写成更接近参考模型的在策略分布，SFT 在泛化与遗忘上就能比肩强在策略后训练。实验覆盖科学技能、数学推理和开放式专长。采样本身可以当作后训练原语，这会动摇"保能力必须上 RL"的默认做法，做后训练的人值得细看。

2. 𝗙𝗶𝗻𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗥𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁 𝗙𝗶𝘁: 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹-𝗛𝗮𝗿𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀 𝗮𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝘀 𝗔𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗧𝗮𝘀𝗸𝘀（《找到合适的搭配：跨 Agent 任务的模型与 Harness 交互》）

链接：https://t.co/txmUWsp8E5

作者背景：Yixuan Li, Bo An 等

模型、harness 与任务必须放在一起评，强模型和厂商自有脚手架都不会稳定领先。66 组配置横跨 OpenHands、DeepSeek Harness、PI、openJiuwen 与三项命令行 agent 基准。Terminal-Bench 4 上，Claude 在 OpenHands 中领先 GPT 7.94 分，在 PI 中落后 30.16 分，五个模型里有四个的最优 harness 随基准改变。作者发布了适配器、评测代码和 6,204 条轨迹，部署 agent 的人可以直接拿来做选型证据。

3. 𝗛𝗶𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘂𝗼𝘂𝘀 𝗗𝗶𝗳𝗳𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗟𝗮𝗻𝗴𝘂𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗠𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹𝘀（《分层连续扩散语言模型》）

链接：https://t.co/dC0fv3j4PU

作者背景：Alexander Schwing（UIUC）等

让连续潜变量成为唯一持续生成状态，token 每步读出并回馈，以缓解离散扩散并行解码时的独立采样断裂。训练目标来自 token 似然的变分界，同规模下在 Sudoku、Countdown 和 LM1B 上优于离散与连续扩散基线。做扩散语言模型的人可以看看它是否真正保住了并行解码中的 token 依赖。

4. 𝗘𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘆 𝗔𝗯𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗜𝘀 𝗮 𝗗𝗼𝘀𝗲: 𝗖𝗼𝘂𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝘄𝗲𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝘀 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗦𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝗦𝗲𝗹𝗳-𝗥𝗲𝗽𝗮𝗶𝗿（《每次消融都是一剂药：反权重与"自修复"的假象》）

链接：https://t.co/IzLv2zqidD

消融后看似补偿的响应，多半来自干预前就存在的反权重，它们随对比强度作仿射响应，与临时自我修复无关。在事实判决任务上，Gemma、Qwen、LLaMA、Mistral 的 81 个下游方向中有 68 个服从该仿射律。GPT-2 Small 的 IOI 电路里，干预能触及的 10 个头有 7 个符合，且全是反权重，斜率还能由固定权重预先估计。做机制可解释性的人可以拿它校准对自修复的判断。

Why I believe it’s still early in Coinsilium’s next chapter. 🟠🟡

Coinsilium has built exposure across several developing areas of crypto and AI. Each offers something different:

🟡 Yellow Network — $YELLOW
Infrastructure for clearing and settling transactions across blockchains. Coinsilium has an allocation of 50 million tokens, subject to vesting. Yellow entered live operation in March 2026.

🤖 Otomato
DeFi portfolio monitoring, intelligence and automation, helping users understand positions across different protocols. Coinsilium holds approximately 1.25% of developer Dyment Labs, plus a token warrant.

🔎 Predictive Labs / Nijinn
Brings prediction-market data together into an intelligence platform for professionals, developers and AI agents. Coinsilium’s reported investment reached US$450,000, representing approximately 14.91%.

🎨 BeatingHeart
Developing generative AI tools for advertising images and video, initially targeting fashion, beauty and lifestyle brands. Coinsilium agreed a convertible loan facility of up to US$250,000 alongside strategic advisory support.

₿ Forza — Bitcoin exposure through $BTC
Coinsilium’s wholly owned subsidiary manages its strategic Bitcoin treasury.

For me, “early days” means these ventures still have opportunities to develop products, attract users and build commercial revenues. Their success—and the value ultimately reaching Coinsilium shareholders—depends on execution.

That’s the longer-term story I’m watching.
